text:
maria_gonzalez: Heads up — GreenFjord (midmarket fintech) showing sustained usage drop. Topline: API calls down 47% WoW, active seats down 2, payment still live but renewal flagged. thinking we should assemble a micro-save ladder rather than a one-off playbook.
kevin_cho: 47% is huge. do we have a cause signal? product, billing, or just usage?
ashley_ng: pulled the session heatmap — biggest dip around their batch job window. looks like retries spiked and latencies > 800ms for a few bursts on 3/14. error rate small but latencies likely triggered downstream backoff.
sam_w: ok this smells ops. can we confirm if they hit any rate-limits or were routed to a cheaper model variant?
maria_gonzalez: @lia-bot did a query, routing shows 21% of their traffic fell back to gpt-3.5-compat during the window due to capacity policy. link: https://console.redwood/test/GreenFjord (internal)
kevin_cho: that fallback + latency spike explains degraded UX. recommend short-term mitigations: 1) immediate dedicated burst for 48h, 2) enable prefix cache for their high-volume endpoints, 3) ops ping and canary to ensure no further fallbacks.
ashley_ng: agree. also propose an enablement touch: 20-min troubleshooting session with their infra lead to explain best practices for batching and KV caching. often customers reduce calls once they understand suggestions.
maria_gonzalez: proposed "reactivation ladder" (micro-saves): tier 1 = automated ops fixes (burst + cache), tier 2 = enablement + quick script to adjust backoff, tier 3 = tailored pricing incentive if we can't restore baseline within 7 days.
sam_w: add step 0: proactive customer note — short, empathetic email explaining we saw regressions and taking immediate steps. we should include telemetry + invite to 20-min call. sample copy: ```Hi GreenFjord — we noticed a drop in requests from your account yesterday. We're running an immediate cap burst and want to schedule a quick call to walk through batching + caching tips. —Maria```
kevin_cho: pricing incentive should be small and time-limited. suggest 30% credit on overage for 1 month if baseline not recovered. helps avoid setting discount precedent.
ashley_ng: created checklist for the enablement call: 1) show heatmap + latency spikes, 2) walk them through prefix caching, 3) quick config snippet for batching, 4) next steps + timeline. paste snippet: ```// enable prefix caching
POST /v1/customers/GreenFjord/cache
{ "policy": "prefix", "ttl": 3600 }```
lia-bot: incident note created: INC-2250003210-GREENFJORD. Assigned to eng-oncall. Priority: P2.
maria_gonzalez: assigning me + @kevin_cho for action ownership. Kevin, can you scope the 48h burst and cost? I'll draft the customer note and schedule the call.
kevin_cho: working on burst config now. estimate cost impact: ~$1.8k for 48h at proposed capacity. will confirm in 30m.
sam_w: i'll book a 20-min slot with their infra lead for tomorrow 10:30 PT. sending calendar invite now.
maria_gonzalez: thanks all. let's treat this as a micro-save experiment: log each step in the account playbook, capture the before/after metrics (api calls, latency p95, seat count) so we can automate this ladder for similar accounts. i'll own metrics capture and retro. :thumbsup:
kevin_cho: quick note — if we see routing fallbacks again we should consider pinning a compatible variant for them temporarily to avoid future regressions.
ashley_ng: adding post-call feedback capture: two short questions in follow-up: 1) Was the fix helpful? 2) Any missing docs or tooling? we'll tag responses in Gainsight.
maria_gonzalez: perfect. closing the thread for now — will update when burst confirmed and invite accepted.
